*** Add File: UITap/App/main.swift
+import UIKit
+UIApplicationMain(CommandLine.argc, CommandLine.unsafeArgv, nil, NSStringFromClass(AppDelegate.self))
+class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
+    var window: UIWindow?
+    func application(_ application: UIApplication, didFinishLaunchingWithOptions options: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool { true }
+}
*** Add File: UITap/UITapTests/UITapTests.swift
+import XCTest
+final class UITapTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testNavigate() {
+        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
+        app.activate()
+        let standup = app.staticTexts["Team Standup"].firstMatch
+        XCTAssertTrue(standup.waitForExistence(timeout: 8))
+        standup.tap()
+        sleep(3)
+        let buttons = app.buttons.allElementsBoundByIndex
+        for b in buttons { print("BUTTON:", b.label) }
+        let screenshot = app.screenshot()
+        let attachment = XCTAttachment(screenshot: screenshot)
+        attachment.name = "room"
+        add(attachment)
+        for b in buttons where b.label.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("invite") || b.label.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("add") {
+            b.tap()
+            break
+        }
+    }
+}
*** End Patch
